claims.text: AI feature development decays when requirements are not persisted.
Scope and architecture should be separate decisions.
Every produced value should have a known provenance.
Development should stop when a required decision has no source.
Existing code should be audited before modifying legacy systems.
Tests do not prove the user-facing feature exists.
Runtime verification should execute the actual application.
The implementation model should not review its own work.
Debugging should test one root-cause hypothesis at a time.
